Live agents are llm-mailroom's 16 (src/config/taxonomy.yaml, agents:); legacy auditors and retired specialists get no view. confirmed is true only where the owner decided; every other entry is a proposal. A change is a metrics.yaml edit plus a refresh of this file in the same commit.
